---
title: "S1 - Selecting Blue Variables (63 variables)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(knitr)

here::i_am('scripts/s1_selecting_blue_variables_63.Rmd')

data_path     <- here("data/general/nuMoM2b_Merged_Dataset.csv")
codebook_path <- here("data/general/HIGHLIGHTED_nuMoM2b_Merged_Dataset_Codebook_9.14.25.xlsx")
out_dir       <- here("outputs/s1")

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r define-blue-cols}
# ============================================================
# Step 1: Define the 63 blue variables
#         (the 7 previously added pink variables are removed)
# ============================================================

blue_cols <- c(
  "PublicID",

  # Demographics / insurance
  "Education",
  "Ins_Govt", "Ins_Mil", "Ins_Comm", "Ins_Pers", "Ins_Othr",
  "V1AF04", "Race", "V1AF10", "V1AF09", "AgeCat_V1",

  # Chronic & medical history
  "ChronHTN",
  "VXXB01ae_FA", "VXXB01ae1_FA",
  "VXXB01ab_FA",
  "V1AD14", "V3FF01a",
  "VXXB01al_FA",
  "VXXB01ah_FA", "VXXB01ai_FA", "VXXB01aj_FA", "VXXB01ak_FA",
  "VXXB01au_FA", "VXXB01av_FA", "VXXB01aw_FA",
  "VXXB01ac_FA",
  "VXXB01af_FA",
  "V1AD12a", "V1AD12b", "V1AD12c", "V1AD12d",
  "VXXB01ap_FA", "VXXB01ag_FA",
  "VXXB01as_FA", "VXXB01at_FA",
  "VXXB01ar_FA",
  "GravCat",

  # Pregnancy & labs
  "CMAC03_wks",
  "V1BA02a",
  "V3BA02b1",
  "V3BA02a1",
  "CMAH01b4", "CMAH01b6", "CMAH01b1",
  "CMDA04a", "CMDA04b",
  "CMBG01",
  "CMAB01a1",

  # Additional clinical item
  "A09A03b3",

  # Visit variables
  "V3AF02", "V3AF05",
  "V1AG02", "V1AG03",

  # Outcome / follow-up
  "V3AF07a", "V3AF07b", "V3AF07c", "V3AF07d", "V3AF07e",
  "V3AF07f", "V3AF07g", "V3AF07h", "V3AF07i"
)

# PublicID is the ID column, not a substantive variable
blue_vars_only <- setdiff(blue_cols, "PublicID")

message("Total blue variables (excl. PublicID): ", length(blue_vars_only))
```

```{r check-and-load}
# ============================================================
# Step 2: Check existence and load data
# ============================================================

all_names <- names(read_csv(data_path, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))
missing_cols <- setdiff(blue_cols, all_names)
present_cols <- intersect(blue_cols, all_names)

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  message("WARNING: columns not found in dataset (skipped):")
  message(paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}
if (length(present_cols) == 0) stop("None of the requested columns exist in the dataset.")

blue_df <- read_csv(
  data_path,
  col_select = all_of(present_cols),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

message("Loaded: ", nrow(blue_df), " rows x ", ncol(blue_df), " cols")
```

```{r codebook-lookup}
# ============================================================
# Step 3: Look up Variable_Type, Variable_Unit_if_Numeric,
#         and Variable_Code_List_if_Coded from codebook
#         for each of the 63 blue variables
# ============================================================

cb <- read_excel(codebook_path, sheet = "nuMoM2b_Variables")

# Identify column names using exact or substring matching
cb_var_col  <- "Variable_Name"
cb_type_col <- "Variable Type"
cb_unit_col <- names(cb)[grepl("Variable Unit", names(cb), fixed = TRUE)][1]
cb_code_col <- "Variable_Code_List_if_Coded"

message("Codebook columns identified:")
message("  var  : ", cb_var_col)
message("  type : ", cb_type_col)
message("  unit : ", cb_unit_col)
message("  code : ", cb_code_col)

cb_small <- cb %>%
  transmute(
    variable      = as.character(.data[[cb_var_col]]),
    Variable_Type = as.character(.data[[cb_type_col]]),
    Variable_Unit = as.character(.data[[cb_unit_col]]),
    Variable_Code = as.character(.data[[cb_code_col]])
  )

# Join codebook info onto the 63 blue variables
lookup_df <- tibble(variable = blue_vars_only) %>%
  left_join(cb_small, by = "variable") %>%
  mutate(
    Variable_Type = if_else(is.na(Variable_Type) | trimws(Variable_Type) == "",
                            "Not found in codebook", trimws(Variable_Type)),
    Variable_Unit = if_else(is.na(Variable_Unit) | trimws(Variable_Unit) %in% c("", "NA"),
                            NA_character_, trimws(Variable_Unit)),
    Variable_Code = if_else(is.na(Variable_Code) | trimws(Variable_Code) %in% c("", "NA"),
                            "NA_or_blank", trimws(Variable_Code))
  )

message("Codebook lookup complete for ", nrow(lookup_df), " variables")
```

```{r missing-rate}
# ============================================================
# Step 5: Missing rate for each of the 63 blue variables
# ============================================================

n_rows <- nrow(blue_df)

missing_rate_df <- tibble(variable = blue_vars_only) %>%
  mutate(
    n_missing    = sapply(variable, function(v) {
      if (v %in% names(blue_df)) sum(is.na(blue_df[[v]])) else NA_integer_
    }),
    n_total      = n_rows,
    missing_rate = round(n_missing / n_total * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  left_join(lookup_df %>% select(variable, Variable_Type, Variable_Code),
            by = "variable") %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_rate))

kable(
  missing_rate_df,
  col.names = c("Variable", "N Missing", "N Total", "Missing Rate (%)",
                "Variable Type", "Variable Code"),
  caption   = "Missing rate for each of the 63 blue variables"
)
```

```{r update-weight}
# ============================================================
# Step 5b: Combine CMAB01a1 (kg) and CMAB01a2 (lbs) into
#          updated_CMAB01a1 (kg), then compute BMI
# ============================================================

# --- Load the two weight columns from the full dataset ---
weight_raw <- read_csv(
  data_path,
  col_select = c("PublicID", "CMAB01a1", "CMAB01a2"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# --- Step 1: Convert lbs -> kg (1 lbs = 0.453592 kg) and merge ---
# Priority: use CMAB01a1 (kg) if available; otherwise convert CMAB01a2 (lbs)
weight_raw <- weight_raw %>%
  mutate(
    CMAB01a1 = as.numeric(CMAB01a1),
    CMAB01a2 = as.numeric(CMAB01a2),
    updated_CMAB01a1 = case_when(
      !is.na(CMAB01a1)               ~ CMAB01a1,                        # already in kg
      !is.na(CMAB01a2)               ~ round(CMAB01a2 * 0.453592, 2),  # convert lbs -> kg
      TRUE                           ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# --- Check missing rate of updated_CMAB01a1 ---
n_total_w   <- nrow(weight_raw)
n_miss_orig <- sum(is.na(weight_raw$CMAB01a1))
n_miss_upd  <- sum(is.na(weight_raw$updated_CMAB01a1))

message("CMAB01a1 original  - N missing: ", n_miss_orig,
        " / ", n_total_w,
        " (", round(n_miss_orig / n_total_w * 100, 2), "%)")
message("updated_CMAB01a1   - N missing: ", n_miss_upd,
        " / ", n_total_w,
        " (", round(n_miss_upd  / n_total_w * 100, 2), "%)")

# Quick summary table
weight_check <- tibble(
  Variable        = c("CMAB01a1 (original, kg)",
                      "CMAB01a2 (original, lbs)",
                      "updated_CMAB01a1 (merged, kg)"),
  N_Missing       = c(sum(is.na(weight_raw$CMAB01a1)),
                      sum(is.na(weight_raw$CMAB01a2)),
                      n_miss_upd),
  N_Total         = n_total_w,
  Missing_Rate_pct = round(c(sum(is.na(weight_raw$CMAB01a1)),
                              sum(is.na(weight_raw$CMAB01a2)),
                              n_miss_upd) / n_total_w * 100, 2)
)

kable(weight_check,
      col.names = c("Variable", "N Missing", "N Total", "Missing Rate (%)"),
      caption   = "Weight variable missing rate before and after combining kg + lbs")

# --- Step 2: Merge updated_CMAB01a1 into blue_df ---
# Replace the original CMAB01a1 with updated_CMAB01a1, keep PublicID for joining
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  left_join(weight_raw %>% select(PublicID, updated_CMAB01a1), by = "PublicID") %>%
  select(-CMAB01a1)   # remove original weight column

# --- Step 3: Compute BMI ---
# BMI = weight(kg) / height(m)^2
# V1BA02a is height in cm -> convert to metres
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(
    V1BA02a = as.numeric(V1BA02a),
    BMI = round(updated_CMAB01a1 / (V1BA02a / 100)^2, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(-updated_CMAB01a1, -V1BA02a)   # drop the two source columns

message("BMI computed. N missing BMI: ", sum(is.na(blue_df$BMI)),
        " / ", nrow(blue_df),
        " (", round(sum(is.na(blue_df$BMI)) / nrow(blue_df) * 100, 2), "%)")
message("blue_df now: ", nrow(blue_df), " rows x ", ncol(blue_df), " cols")
```

```{r missing-rate-updated}
# ============================================================
# Step 5c: Recompute missing rate after weight/BMI update
#          (updated variable list: CMAB01a1 & V1BA02a removed,
#           BMI added)
# ============================================================

# Build the updated variable list
blue_vars_updated <- c(
  setdiff(blue_vars_only, c("CMAB01a1", "V1BA02a")),
  "BMI"
)

n_rows_upd <- nrow(blue_df)

missing_rate_updated_df <- tibble(variable = blue_vars_updated) %>%
  mutate(
    n_missing    = sapply(variable, function(v) {
      if (v %in% names(blue_df)) sum(is.na(blue_df[[v]])) else NA_integer_
    }),
    n_total      = n_rows_upd,
    missing_rate = round(n_missing / n_total * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  left_join(lookup_df %>% select(variable, Variable_Type, Variable_Code),
            by = "variable") %>%
  mutate(
    # BMI is not in codebook lookup — fill manually
    Variable_Type = if_else(variable == "BMI" & is.na(Variable_Type),
                            "Numeric", Variable_Type),
    Variable_Code = if_else(variable == "BMI" & is.na(Variable_Code),
                            "NA_or_blank", Variable_Code)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_rate))

n_vars_updated <- length(blue_vars_updated)

kable(
  missing_rate_updated_df,
  col.names = c("Variable", "N Missing", "N Total", "Missing Rate (%)",
                "Variable Type", "Variable Code"),
  caption   = paste0("Missing rate for each of the ", n_vars_updated,
                     " variables (after combining weight columns and computing BMI)")
)
```

```{r merge-variables}
# ============================================================
# Step 5d: Merge groups of variables into single indicators
# ============================================================

# Helper: any_flag() — returns 1 if any column equals 1,
#                       NA if all columns are NA (so downstream NA recoding applies),
#                       0 otherwise
any_flag <- function(df, cols) {
  present_cols <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(present_cols) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(df)))
  mat <- df %>% select(all_of(present_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    if (any(!is.na(x) & x == 1)) 1
    else if (all(is.na(x)))      NA_real_
    else                         0
  })
}

# --- 1. Ins: any of the 5 insurance variables = 1 ---
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(Ins = any_flag(., c("Ins_Govt","Ins_Mil","Ins_Comm","Ins_Pers","Ins_Othr"))) %>%
  select(-Ins_Govt, -Ins_Mil, -Ins_Comm, -Ins_Pers, -Ins_Othr)

# --- 2. Diabetes: VXXB01ae_FA or VXXB01ae1_FA = 1 ---
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(Diabetes = any_flag(., c("VXXB01ae_FA","VXXB01ae1_FA"))) %>%
  select(-VXXB01ae_FA, -VXXB01ae1_FA)

# --- 3. Sleep_Apnea: V1AD14 or V3FF01a = 1 ---
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(Sleep_Apnea = any_flag(., c("V1AD14","V3FF01a"))) %>%
  select(-V1AD14, -V3FF01a)

# --- 4. Cardiac_Disease: any of VXXB01ah/ai/aj/ak_FA = 1 ---
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(Cardiac_Disease = any_flag(., c("VXXB01ah_FA","VXXB01ai_FA",
                                          "VXXB01aj_FA","VXXB01ak_FA"))) %>%
  select(-VXXB01ah_FA, -VXXB01ai_FA, -VXXB01aj_FA, -VXXB01ak_FA)

# --- 5. Autoimmune_Disease: any of VXXB01au/av/aw_FA = 1 ---
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(Autoimmune_Disease = any_flag(., c("VXXB01au_FA","VXXB01av_FA","VXXB01aw_FA"))) %>%
  select(-VXXB01au_FA, -VXXB01av_FA, -VXXB01aw_FA)

# --- 6. Thyroid_Disorder: VXXB01af_FA or VXXB01ag_FA = 1 ---
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(Thyroid_Disorder = any_flag(., c("VXXB01af_FA","VXXB01ag_FA"))) %>%
  select(-VXXB01af_FA, -VXXB01ag_FA)

# --- 7. Prior_Uterine_Surgery: any of V1AD12a/b/c/d = 1 ---
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(Prior_Uterine_Surgery = any_flag(., c("V1AD12a","V1AD12b","V1AD12c","V1AD12d"))) %>%
  select(-V1AD12a, -V1AD12b, -V1AD12c, -V1AD12d)

# --- 8. Bleeding_Disorder: VXXB01as_FA or VXXB01at_FA = 1 ---
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(Bleeding_Disorder = any_flag(., c("VXXB01as_FA","VXXB01at_FA"))) %>%
  select(-VXXB01as_FA, -VXXB01at_FA)

# --- 9. Tobacco_Use: V3AF02 or V3AF05 = 1 ---
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(Tobacco_Use = any_flag(., c("V3AF02","V3AF05"))) %>%
  select(-V3AF02, -V3AF05)

# --- 10. Alcohol_Use: V1AG02 or V1AG03 = 1 ---
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(Alcohol_Use = any_flag(., c("V1AG02","V1AG03"))) %>%
  select(-V1AG02, -V1AG03)

# --- 11. Drug_Use: any of V3AF07a-i = 1 ---
blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(Drug_Use = any_flag(., c("V3AF07a","V3AF07b","V3AF07c","V3AF07d",
                                   "V3AF07e","V3AF07f","V3AF07g","V3AF07h","V3AF07i"))) %>%
  select(-V3AF07a, -V3AF07b, -V3AF07c, -V3AF07d,
         -V3AF07e, -V3AF07f, -V3AF07g, -V3AF07h, -V3AF07i)

# ============================================================
# Step 5d-2: Recode values by variable type
#
# Yes_No_v1 variables: 1 = Yes, 2 = No -> recode 2 to 0, NA stays NA
# Checked variables:   NA -> 0  (1 = checked/present, 0 = not present / missing)
# ============================================================

yes_no_vars <- c("Ins", "Sleep_Apnea", "Prior_Uterine_Surgery",
                 "Tobacco_Use", "Alcohol_Use", "Drug_Use",
                 "CMDA04a", "CMDA04b", "CMBG01",
                 "ChronHTN")

checked_vars <- c("Diabetes", "Cardiac_Disease", "Autoimmune_Disease",
                  "Thyroid_Disorder", "Bleeding_Disorder",
                  "VXXB01ab_FA", "VXXB01al_FA", "VXXB01ac_FA",
                  "VXXB01ap_FA", "VXXB01ar_FA", "A09A03b3")

# --- Record Ins missing rate BEFORE recoding ---
ins_n_missing_before <- sum(is.na(blue_df$Ins))
ins_n_total          <- nrow(blue_df)
ins_miss_rate_before <- round(ins_n_missing_before / ins_n_total * 100, 2)

# Yes_No_v1: recode 2 -> 0 and NA -> 0  (1 = Yes, 0 = No/Missing)
for (v in yes_no_vars) {
  if (v %in% names(blue_df)) {
    blue_df[[v]] <- as.numeric(blue_df[[v]])
    blue_df[[v]][is.na(blue_df[[v]]) | blue_df[[v]] == 2] <- 0
  }
}

# Checked: NA -> 0
for (v in checked_vars) {
  if (v %in% names(blue_df)) {
    blue_df[[v]] <- as.numeric(blue_df[[v]])
    blue_df[[v]][is.na(blue_df[[v]])] <- 0
  }
}

message("After merging and NA recoding: blue_df now has ",
        nrow(blue_df), " rows x ", ncol(blue_df), " cols")
message("Variables remaining (excl. PublicID): ",
        paste(setdiff(names(blue_df), "PublicID"), collapse = ", "))
```

```{r missing-rate-final}
# ============================================================
# Step 5e: Missing rate table for the final 35 variables
# ============================================================

final_vars <- setdiff(names(blue_df), "PublicID")
n_final    <- length(final_vars)
n_rows_fin <- nrow(blue_df)

# Manually define type/code for the 11 newly derived variables
derived_meta <- tibble(
  variable      = c("Ins", "Diabetes", "Sleep_Apnea", "Cardiac_Disease",
                    "Autoimmune_Disease", "Thyroid_Disorder", "Prior_Uterine_Surgery",
                    "Bleeding_Disorder", "Tobacco_Use", "Alcohol_Use", "Drug_Use"),
  Variable_Type = "Coded",
  Variable_Code = "0/1 (derived)"
)

# Combine codebook lookup with derived metadata
lookup_final <- lookup_df %>%
  select(variable, Variable_Type, Variable_Code) %>%
  bind_rows(derived_meta) %>%
  # BMI from earlier step
  bind_rows(tibble(variable = "BMI",
                   Variable_Type = "Numeric",
                   Variable_Code = "NA_or_blank")) %>%
  distinct(variable, .keep_all = TRUE)

missing_rate_final_df <- tibble(variable = final_vars) %>%
  mutate(
    n_missing    = sapply(variable, function(v) {
      if (v %in% names(blue_df)) sum(is.na(blue_df[[v]])) else NA_integer_
    }),
    n_total      = n_rows_fin,
    missing_rate = round(n_missing / n_total * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  left_join(lookup_final, by = "variable") %>%
  mutate(
    Variable_Type = if_else(is.na(Variable_Type), "Not found in codebook", Variable_Type),
    Variable_Code = if_else(is.na(Variable_Code), "NA_or_blank", Variable_Code)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_rate))

kable(
  missing_rate_final_df,
  col.names = c("Variable", "N Missing", "N Total", "Missing Rate (%)",
                "Variable Type", "Variable Code"),
  caption   = paste0("Missing rate for each of the ", n_final,
                     " final variables (after all merging steps)")
)

# --- Ins: missing rate before vs after recoding ---
ins_n_missing_after <- sum(is.na(blue_df$Ins))
ins_comparison <- tibble(
  Stage         = c("After merging (before recode)",
                    "After recode (2 -> 0, NA stays NA)"),
  N_Missing     = c(ins_n_missing_before, ins_n_missing_after),
  N_Total       = ins_n_total,
  Missing_Rate  = c(ins_miss_rate_before,
                    round(ins_n_missing_after / ins_n_total * 100, 2))
)

kable(
  ins_comparison,
  col.names = c("Stage", "N Missing", "N Total", "Missing Rate (%)"),
  caption   = "Ins: missing rate before and after recoding 2 -> 0 (NA unchanged)"
)
```

```{r value-distribution}
# ============================================================
# Step 5f: Unique value distribution for all final variables
#          (proportion of each unique value per variable)
# ============================================================

library(ggplot2)

final_vars_plot <- setdiff(names(blue_df), "PublicID")
n_total_plot    <- nrow(blue_df)

# Build a long-form summary: for each variable, count each unique value
dist_df <- purrr::map_dfr(final_vars_plot, function(v) {
  x <- blue_df[[v]]
  tbl <- table(x, useNA = "always")
  tibble(
    variable  = v,
    value     = names(tbl),
    n         = as.integer(tbl),
    pct       = round(as.integer(tbl) / n_total_plot * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
    mutate(value = if_else(is.na(value) | value == "NA", "NA", as.character(value)))
})

# Plot: one facet per variable, bars = unique values, y = percentage
n_vars_plot <- length(final_vars_plot)

ggplot(dist_df, aes(x = value, y = pct, fill = value)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x",
             ncol = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Value distribution for each of the ", n_vars_plot, " final variables"),
    x     = "Value",
    y     = "Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.title       = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing    = unit(0.4, "lines")
  )
```

```{r check-non-numeric}
# ============================================================
# Step 5g: Check which final variables are not numeric
# ============================================================

final_vars_check <- setdiff(names(blue_df), "PublicID")
n_total_check    <- nrow(blue_df)

# Directly check variable type using is.numeric()
non_numeric_vars <- Filter(function(v) !is.numeric(blue_df[[v]]), final_vars_check)

if (length(non_numeric_vars) == 0) {
  message("All final variables are numeric.")
} else {
  message("Non-numeric variables found: ", paste(non_numeric_vars, collapse = ", "))

  # For each non-numeric variable, show only non-numeric unique values and their proportions
  non_numeric_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(non_numeric_vars, function(v) {
    x <- blue_df[[v]]
    tbl <- table(as.character(x), useNA = "always")
    tibble(
      Variable       = v,
      Unique_Value   = names(tbl),
      N              = as.integer(tbl),
      Proportion_pct = round(as.integer(tbl) / n_total_check * 100, 2)
    ) %>%
      mutate(Unique_Value = if_else(is.na(Unique_Value) | Unique_Value == "NA",
                                    "NA", Unique_Value)) %>%
      # Keep only values that cannot be converted to numeric (excluding NA)
      filter(Unique_Value == "NA" | is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Unique_Value)))) %>%
      arrange(desc(N))
  })

  kable(
    non_numeric_summary,
    col.names = c("Variable", "Unique Value", "N", "Proportion (%)"),
    caption   = paste0("Unique values and proportions for ",
                       length(non_numeric_vars),
                       " non-numeric variable(s) in the final dataset")
  )
}
```

```{r recode-non-numeric-to-na}
# ============================================================
# Step 5h: Replace all non-numeric values (e.g. "D", "R") with NA
#          across all final variables, so Python KNN imputer
#          can handle them directly as NaN
# ============================================================

final_vars_recode <- setdiff(names(blue_df), "PublicID")

blue_df <- blue_df %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(final_vars_recode),
    ~ {
      x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.x)))
      # Where original is not NA but conversion failed -> set to NA
      ifelse(!is.na(.x) & is.na(x_num), NA_real_, x_num)
    }
  ))

# Verify: re-run non-numeric check to confirm all clean
remaining_non_numeric <- Filter(function(v) !is.numeric(blue_df[[v]]), final_vars_recode)

if (length(remaining_non_numeric) == 0) {
  message("All variables are now numeric. Non-numeric values successfully replaced with NA.")
} else {
  message("WARNING: still non-numeric variables remaining: ",
          paste(remaining_non_numeric, collapse = ", "))
}

message("blue_df now: ", nrow(blue_df), " rows x ", ncol(blue_df), " cols")
```

```{r check-non-numeric-after-recode}
# ============================================================
# Step 5h-2: Re-check non-numeric variables after recoding
#            (same as Step 5g, to verify the fix worked)
# ============================================================

final_vars_check2 <- setdiff(names(blue_df), "PublicID")
n_total_check2    <- nrow(blue_df)

non_numeric_vars2 <- Filter(function(v) !is.numeric(blue_df[[v]]), final_vars_check2)

if (length(non_numeric_vars2) == 0) {
  message("All final variables are numeric. No non-numeric values remaining.")
} else {
  message("Non-numeric variables still found: ", paste(non_numeric_vars2, collapse = ", "))

  non_numeric_summary2 <- purrr::map_dfr(non_numeric_vars2, function(v) {
    x <- blue_df[[v]]
    tbl <- table(as.character(x), useNA = "always")
    tibble(
      Variable       = v,
      Unique_Value   = names(tbl),
      N              = as.integer(tbl),
      Proportion_pct = round(as.integer(tbl) / n_total_check2 * 100, 2)
    ) %>%
      mutate(Unique_Value = if_else(is.na(Unique_Value) | Unique_Value == "NA",
                                    "NA", Unique_Value)) %>%
      filter(Unique_Value == "NA" | is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Unique_Value)))) %>%
      arrange(desc(N))
  })

  kable(
    non_numeric_summary2,
    col.names = c("Variable", "Unique Value", "N", "Proportion (%)"),
    caption   = paste0("Remaining non-numeric unique values after recoding (",
                       length(non_numeric_vars2), " variable(s))")
  )
}
```

```{r one-hot-encoding}
# ============================================================
# Step 5i: One-hot encoding for non-ordinal categorical variables
#          with more than 3 categories:
#          - Race       (1-9, Race/Ethnicity)
#          - V1AF04     (1-5 + R, Marital Status; R already recoded to NA)
# ============================================================

# Helper: one_hot() — takes a df, a column name, and a prefix,
#                     returns the df with the original column replaced
#                     by dummy columns (drop first to avoid multicollinearity)
one_hot <- function(df, col, prefix) {
  x <- as.integer(df[[col]])
  levels_present <- sort(unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
  # Drop first level to avoid perfect multicollinearity
  levels_to_encode <- levels_present[-1]
  for (lv in levels_to_encode) {
    new_col <- paste0(prefix, "_", lv)
    df[[new_col]] <- if_else(is.na(x), NA_real_,
                             if_else(x == lv, 1, 0))
  }
  df[[col]] <- NULL  # remove original column
  df
}

# ============================================================
# Step 5i-a: Race value distribution BEFORE one-hot encoding
# ============================================================

race_codebook <- c(
  "1" = "Non-Hispanic White (reference, will be dropped)",
  "2" = "Non-Hispanic Black",
  "3" = "Hispanic",
  "4" = "American Indian",
  "5" = "Asian",
  "6" = "Native Hawaiian",
  "7" = "Other",
  "8" = "Multiracial",
  "9" = "Missing"
)

race_before <- table(blue_df[["Race"]], useNA = "always")
race_before_df <- tibble(
  Race_value = names(race_before),
  N          = as.integer(race_before),
  Pct        = round(as.integer(race_before) / nrow(blue_df) * 100, 2),
  Category   = dplyr::recode(names(race_before),
                              !!!race_codebook,
                              .missing = "NA / Missing")
) %>%
  arrange(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Race_value)))

message("--------------------------------------------------")
message("Race value distribution BEFORE one-hot encoding:")
message("--------------------------------------------------")
kable(
  race_before_df,
  col.names = c("Race value", "N", "% of total", "Category (nuMoM2b codebook)"),
  caption   = "Race: unique value counts BEFORE one-hot encoding (reference = 1, Non-Hispanic White)"
)

# --- Race: reference category = 1 (Non-Hispanic White) ---
blue_df <- one_hot(blue_df, "Race", "Race")

# --- V1AF04 (Marital Status): reference category = 1 (Single, never married) ---
blue_df <- one_hot(blue_df, "V1AF04", "Marital")

message("After one-hot encoding: blue_df now has ",
        nrow(blue_df), " rows x ", ncol(blue_df), " cols")
message("New dummy columns added: ",
        paste(grep("^Race_|^Marital_", names(blue_df), value = TRUE),
              collapse = ", "))

# ============================================================
# Step 5i-b: Race dummy column distribution AFTER one-hot encoding
# Shows: for each Race_N column, how many rows are 1, 0, and NA
# ============================================================

race_dummy_cols <- sort(grep("^Race_", names(blue_df), value = TRUE))

race_after_codebook <- c(
  "Race_2" = "Non-Hispanic Black",
  "Race_3" = "Hispanic",
  "Race_4" = "American Indian",
  "Race_5" = "Asian",
  "Race_6" = "Native Hawaiian",
  "Race_7" = "Other",
  "Race_8" = "Multiracial",
  "Race_9" = "Missing"
)

n_total_after <- nrow(blue_df)

race_after_df <- purrr::map_dfr(race_dummy_cols, function(col) {
  x <- blue_df[[col]]
  n_one  <- sum(x == 1,  na.rm = TRUE)
  n_zero <- sum(x == 0,  na.rm = TRUE)
  n_na   <- sum(is.na(x))
  tibble(
    Column   = col,
    Category = race_after_codebook[col],
    `N (=1)` = n_one,
    `% (=1)` = round(n_one  / n_total_after * 100, 2),
    `N (=0)` = n_zero,
    `% (=0)` = round(n_zero / n_total_after * 100, 2),
    `N (NA)` = n_na,
    `% (NA)` = round(n_na   / n_total_after * 100, 2)
  )
})

message("--------------------------------------------------")
message("Race dummy column distribution AFTER one-hot encoding:")
message("--------------------------------------------------")
kable(
  race_after_df,
  caption = "Race: dummy column value distribution AFTER one-hot encoding"
)
```
